content: 第十三关（前）
5:57 A.M. \ Cloudy \ Visibility: 17 km

raw: [name=""]   Desert; 4 km from the outskirts of Lungmen
content: Desert; 4 km from the outskirts of Lungmen

raw: [name=""]   4 days after the Chernobog rescue mission
content: 4 days after the Chernobog rescue mission

raw: [name="PRTS"]   Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}. You have currently been sleeping for 99999----
speaker: PRTS
content: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}. You have currently been sleeping for 99999----

raw: [name="PRTS"]   Although your reluctance to leave bed is not beyond reason, your presence is urgently needed at the operations command room.
speaker: PRTS
content: Although your reluctance to leave bed is not beyond reason, your presence is urgently needed at the operations command room.

raw: [name="PRTS"]   Furthermore, here is some medical advice from Dr. Kal'tsit: Please keep the windows open to maintain a source of fresh air, and spend some time on the deck to maintain healthy levels of Vitamin D.
speaker: PRTS
content: Furthermore, here is some medical advice from Dr. Kal'tsit: Please keep the windows open to maintain a source of fresh air, and spend some time on the deck to maintain healthy levels of Vitamin D.

speaker: Amiya
content: Ah, Doctor! Good morning.

speaker: Dobermann
content: So you made it, Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Doctor, are you feeling better now?
speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor, are you feeling better now?

raw: [name="Amiya"]   You looked like you were still in pain and and couldn't move around well yesterday.
speaker: Amiya
content: You looked like you were still in pain and and couldn't move around well yesterday.

raw: [Decision(options="I've made a complete recovery. How about you?", values="1")]
options: I've made a complete recovery. How about you?

raw: [name="Amiya"]   I'm perfectly fine and full of energy today!
speaker: Amiya
content: I'm perfectly fine and full of energy today!

raw: [name="Amiya"]   After all, we still have other missions to take care of...
speaker: Amiya
content: After all, we still have other missions to take care of...

raw: [name="Amiya"]   So the sooner we can start preparing, the better. Doctor, you should get used to having to shift gears quickly here.
speaker: Amiya
content: So the sooner we can start preparing, the better. Doctor, you should get used to having to shift gears quickly here.

speaker: Dobermann
content: Doctor,

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Even though we sustained heavy losses in Chernobog, we gained a lot of information about Reunion and, more importantly, got you out alive.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Even though we sustained heavy losses in Chernobog, we gained a lot of information about Reunion and, more importantly, got you out alive.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Based on the negotiations we had yesterday, the closest nomadic city to us, Lungmen, has offered us a cooperation pact and agreed to exchange information with us.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Based on the negotiations we had yesterday, the closest nomadic city to us, Lungmen, has offered us a cooperation pact and agreed to exchange information with us.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  We have some evidence that Reunion might be targeting Lungmen next.
speaker: Dobermann
content: We have some evidence that Reunion might be targeting Lungmen next.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  We'll have to wait for Dr. Kal'tsit's permission first before we can get the rest of the information. She's still stationed within Lungmen.
speaker: Dobermann
content: We'll have to wait for Dr. Kal'tsit's permission first before we can get the rest of the information. She's still stationed within Lungmen.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   Lungmen has granted us permission to temporary camp near the city. They've also agreed to compensate a portion of our losses and expenditures during the operation.
speaker: Amiya
content: Lungmen has granted us permission to temporary camp near the city. They've also agreed to compensate a portion of our losses and expenditures during the operation.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   In exchanges, Rhodes Island is expected to help defend the city's outskirts.
speaker: Amiya
content: In exchanges, Rhodes Island is expected to help defend the city's outskirts.

raw: [name="Amiya"]   But the reason why I called for you so early is...
speaker: Amiya
content: But the reason why I called for you so early is...

speaker: Dobermann
content: Let me explain it, Amiya.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Last night, we discovered another wave of Chernobog survivors making their way towards Lungmen. They're expected to get there in the afternoon.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Last night, we discovered another wave of Chernobog survivors making their way towards Lungmen. They're expected to get there in the afternoon.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  We'll be expected to safeguard the outskirts of District 5 just like the last few days. Only this time, there might be more Reunion members mixed into the group.
speaker: Dobermann
content: We'll be expected to safeguard the outskirts of District 5 just like the last few days. Only this time, there might be more Reunion members mixed into the group.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Because the situation is a bit different, we'll need to discuss some new tactics with you before beginning the operation.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Because the situation is a bit different, we'll need to discuss some new tactics with you before beginning the operation.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Anyway, Doctor, there's a lot to get through today, so...
speaker: Amiya
content: Anyway, Doctor, there's a lot to get through today, so...

speaker: Amiya
content: Let's do our best!

speaker: Dobermann
content: In any case...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Both of you, please complete your combat preparations. Doctor, once you've decided on your squad assignments, please let the operators know so that they also have time to prepare.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Both of you, please complete your combat preparations. Doctor, once you've decided on your squad assignments, please let the operators know so that they also have time to prepare.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  We'll set out 15 minutes after you finish your drills.
speaker: Dobermann
content: We'll set out 15 minutes after you finish your drills.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Oh, and make sure you're not late this time.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Oh, and make sure you're not late this time.
